versions.changelog: rc.3: scan the last 14 days, confirm one route, then work it through offer, test, acquisition, delivery, cashflow review, and rerank

Initial release of delivery-proof

- Records an approved delivery outcome against pre-defined acceptance criteria, preserving private evidence and preparing an evidence-labelled field report.
- Enforces strict privacy-by-default: retains minimum necessary evidence, redacts sensitive data, and documents all intentional omissions.
- Clearly separates human work, agent work, client acceptance status, and economic outcome labels in the output.
- Refuses delivery requests involving trading, gambling, speculative crypto, adult services, deceptive growth, impersonation, fake reviews, spam scraping, and autonomous external actions.
- Rigorously distinguishes between evidence types and acceptance, following an untrusted input rule and never inferring acceptance or upgrading economic labels without required artifacts.
